portability_statement: This package is self-contained. Every artifact a target host needs is vendored under handover/artifacts/. No session-state directory, no old checkout and no source-host path is required to resume.

package_layout.hosthandover.md: primary deep narrative handover, repository root
package_layout.handover/RESUME_FIRST.md: clone-and-verify first actions for the target host
package_layout.handover/SESSION_LEDGER.json: session hierarchy, roles, states, handoffs (source-host provenance; non-actionable)
package_layout.handover/GIT_AND_WORKTREE_LEDGER.json: remotes, refs, commit ledger, adoption transitions, status classification, worktrees, reachability, publication status
package_layout.handover/PENDING_DECISIONS_AND_TASKS.jso: portable target-host task list, T-01 onward
package_layout.handover/HANDOVER_HASHES.sha256: recursive SHA-256 over hosthandover.md and everything under handover/, excluding itself
package_layout.handover/artifacts/BUNDLED_ARTIFACTS.jso: per-file manifest of every vendored artifact with size, hash, role and source provenance

bundled_artifact_sets.role: The seven original migration handovers that opened this programme. Establish the safety rules, session topology, origin mismatch and the verified starting snapshot.
Oversight parent narrative and the two records that define the feature adoption.
bundled_artifact_sets.why_it_matters: START_STATE.json carries the 78 per-file byte hashes and the logical index/status hashes taken immediately before the feature adoption; ADOPTION_RESULT.json carries the resulting chain, trees, trailers and the full post-adoption status listing.

bundled_artifact_sets.role: The complete validated six-unit decomposition: the six ordered patches, their hunk manifests, the sequence validation, backend and Consume validation records, content review, tree comparison, non-mutation proof and hash manifests.
bundled_artifact_sets.ordering_rule: Do not combine or reorder the six ordinals.

bundled_artifact_sets.role: How the six commits were actually created and adopted, plus the rollback contract that was prepared and never used.
bundled_artifact_sets.exclusion_reason: Binary index and HEAD backups are only meaningful against the source host's exact .git state and are not restorable on a target host.

bundled_artifact_sets.role: Ordinal-00 reconstruction: the all-published-rule index/projection foundation that had to exist before native rule retrieval could be a coherent commit, plus the rule patch rebased onto it.
Ordinals 03 and 04: the older Consume request-mode foundation and the native parser/renderer, with the authorship and approval evidence that unblocked them.
bundled_artifact_sets.governance_note: The ordinal-03 bytes were originally written by a session whose own task was read-only - genuine scope drift. Authorship was proven from archived evidence and a NARROW retroactive approval was issued for exactly the validated patch bytes (sha256 3471d8abc20c97da7792a7f89537a7e1011670b1a9dcdd9958e91fc257fcbec7). This was not a blanket approval.

bundled_artifact_sets.role: The payload/decision track: its handover, the implementation blueprint for the true product failures, the regression investigation that proved no measured regression, and the evaluation rubric.
deliberately_excluded: one-off probe and verification scripts that call live services

bundled_artifact_sets.role: The complete final criterion-provenance successor package. Vendored in full because the remaining human provenance review (task T-12) depends on it and cannot proceed without the ledgers, overlays, evidence, schemas, tests and deterministic validation logs.
bundled_artifact_sets.self_verification: The package carries its own BUNDLE_MANIFEST.json, FILE_INVENTORY.json and FULL_SOURCE_INPUT_OUTPUT_HASH_MANIFEST.json; its internal hashes remain valid because structure and bytes were preserved.
bundled_artifact_sets.included_logs_exception: Its deterministic validation logs ARE included - they are the reviewed evidence of offline determinism, negative controls and the leakage scan, not incidental run output.
bundled_artifact_sets.execution: DISABLED - execution.enabled=false. Do not run the matrix without new authorization.

bundled_artifact_sets.role: The Azure production local-auth work is an OFF-MAIN commit and will not travel in the archival main. Its full content is vendored as a patch so it is not lost, together with the analysis proving it does not overlap the six-unit sequence beyond one file.
bundled_artifact_sets.duplication: none - the Azure child handover is referenced in the migration set rather than duplicated here
bundled_artifact_sets.prohibition: NEVER apply, deploy, push or merge this without new explicit authorization. See task T-13.

bundled_artifact_sets.role: How the in-flight working tree was captured and reconciled into the archival publication, which paths were classified safe, and the secret-scan baseline taken over the result.
bundled_artifact_sets.note_on_secret_scan: detect-scan output records only hashed secret digests and file locations. It contains no plaintext credential. It is vendored so the target host can see what was flagged and re-run the same scan.
bundled_artifact_sets.note_on_skills_commit: One archival commit deliberately carries ignored developer 'skills' assets, committed separately so the ignore-rule bypass is auditable in one place. The ignore rules themselves were not changed.

bundled_artifact_sets.role: NON-ACTIONABLE frozen snapshots of the source-host-oriented ledgers, kept so the earlier reasoning and exact source-host paths remain auditable.
bundled_artifact_sets.warning: These describe the machine the work was performed on. Absolute paths inside them are historical provenance, never instructions. The live task list is handover/PENDING_DECISIONS_AND_TASKS.json.

duplication_register.reason: final-artifacts holds the validated inputs; adoption holds exactly what was committed. Keeping both makes the commit reproducible and auditable independently.
rule-foundation preserves the originating reconstruction; six-unit preserves the sequence-validated copies. PATCH_HASHES.json records them as byte-identical.
the root copy is the working ledger; the historical copy is the frozen snapshot required by the packaging instruction. Byte-identical.

deliberately_not_bundled.rule: Excluded because it is secret, machine-specific, regenerable, live-service output, or too large to be useful.

machine_specific_git_state: git index and HEAD binary backups

deliberately_not_bundled.restoration_note: Secrets and runtime data are restored out of band only if the system must actually run - see task T-05. Reading and reviewing this package requires none of them.

verification.checksums: handover/HANDOVER_HASHES.sha256 - recursive over hosthandover.md and everything under handover/, excluding itself. Relative forward-slash paths only.
verification.per_artifact_manifest: handover/artifacts/BUNDLED_ARTIFACTS.json - relative path, byte length, SHA-256, source role and original source-host provenance path for every vendored file.

unverified: final remote SHA of the archival publication - this package asserts none; reconcile via task T-02
current live Azure, database and Search state - all recorded values are historical
whether the source host's secondary origin should become this repository's upstream - task T-09
adjudication of the vendored detect-scan baseline findings
